notes.title: 🛠️ Bug Fix – Lathe Workpiece Creation Restored (v1.44)
notes.notes:
Hello machinists 👋

We want to apologize for a recent bug that slipped through:
when opening the New Workpiece window for the Lathe, materials were missing and creating a new workpiece didn’t work at all.

🔧 This issue is now fixed!

Materials now display correctly.

Workpiece creation for the lathe works as intended.

We’re sorry for the inconvenience this caused, and we appreciate everyone who reported the issue so quickly. Your feedback helps us keep the workshop running smoothly.

As always, if you spot anything else that feels off, let us know on the forums or Discord — we’re listening 👂

Happy machining, and thank you for sticking with us! 🙌

notes.title: CNC Milling Machine Bug Fix Update – Edge Finder Issue Resolved
notes.notes:
Hey machinists 👋

We owe you an apology on this one — there was a frustrating bug in the CNC Milling Machine DLC where the tool simply wouldn’t cut if the Edge Finder was active. We know how important precision is in machining, and this definitely wasn’t the experience we wanted you to have.

✅ The good news: this issue is now fixed! Your tools will cut properly even with the Edge Finder turned on.

Thank you all for spotting this and letting us know so quickly. Your feedback helps us keep making the simulator sharper, smoother, and closer to the real workshop.

Keep sending us your reports and suggestions — we’re listening! 🙌

notes.title: 🛠️ Update: Workpiece Scaling Fix + General Improvements
notes.notes:
📏 Improved Unit Handling for Workpiece Previews

We’ve fixed a major issue where selecting Show Model on the Select Workpiece scene would incorrectly scale the preview model — especially when units were set to INCH. In some cases, the workpiece appeared up to 24 times larger than intended. This is now resolved, and models display accurately based on the selected unit system.



✅ Additional Fixes:

General bug fixes and stability improvements across multiple scenes.

Improved reliability when switching between unit modes.

Minor UI polish and optimization.

Thanks for your feedback and support — keep machining, and happy simulating!



🔧 We're also hard at work on our upcoming CNC Milling Machine DLC — stay tuned for more details soon!

notes.title: Release 1.31
notes.notes:
Update Notes:
We are excited to bring you a new update with several improvements, fixes, and new features for both Milling Machine Simulator and the Lathe DLC. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

Added:
Hotkey Functionality: The F key is now a dedicated hotkey for turning the machine on and off.
Calculator Update: Numpad keys are now fully supported in the calculator for easier input.

Changed:
Clamps Adjustment: In all clamps (Vise, Dividing head, Chuck, Drill Chuck), you no longer need to fully open the clamps to adjust the workpiece or tool inside them, allowing for a smoother workflow.

Fixed:
STL and OBJ Export: We resolved issues with exporting the workpiece to STL and OBJ formats.
Calculator Focus Issue: Fixed a bug where numbers were still being typed into the calculator even when the focus was on another input field.
Undo Feature: Addressed an issue where the Undo function wasn't working properly.

We hope these changes improve your experience with the game. As always, keep the feedback coming and enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Release 1.29
notes.notes:
Dear Machinists,

We are thrilled to announce a brand-new update for Milling Machine Simulator on Steam! This update brings several exciting features and crucial fixes to enhance your simulation experience.

What's New?
Milling Machine Simulator


 Enhanced Control Panel: We’ve added a vise, dividing head, and tool holder controller to the top of the window, just like in Lathe Machine. This will give you even more control and precision in your machining projects.
 Improved T-slot Tool: We’ve fixed an issue where the height was not being cut correctly and the stem diameter was not set properly. Your T-slot tool will now perform with the accuracy you expect.
 Tool Holder Dynamics: Tools can now fall off the tool holder, adding an extra layer of realism. Be sure to keep an eye on your tools!


Milling Machine and Lathe Machine DLC


 Coolant Visibility Fix: We’ve addressed an issue where the coolant was not visible in some cases. Your machine’s coolant will now display correctly, ensuring optimal performance.
 Custom Camera Positions: We now support manually setting camera positions for the F1, F2, and F3 buttons. Personalize your workspace and get the perfect view for your machining tasks.
 We hope these updates bring more realism and enjoyment to your simulation experience. Your feedback has been invaluable in making these improvements, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts on these new features.


Thank you for your continued support and happy machining!

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those chips flying!

Best regards,

The Milling Machine Simulator Team

notes.title: Release 1.22
notes.notes:
Milling Machine 3D - Update Notes:

Fixes:

Tool Change Improvement: You no longer need to move the tool entirely outside the workpiece boundaries to change it. It's sufficient for the tool to not be in contact with any part of the mesh.
Mouse Interaction: Resolved an issue where mouse camera interaction was unresponsive when the mouse hovered over the status bar at the bottom of the screen.

Additions:

Vise/Dividing Head Status: A status text has been added to the vise/dividing head controller indicating if it's in an "opened" or "closed" state.
Interruptible Actions: You can now interrupt the opening or closing action of the vise/dividing head by pressing the respective button again.


Lathe Machine DLC - Update Notes:

Fixes:

Tool Change Improvement: Tools can now be changed without needing to be moved entirely out of the workpiece boundaries. It's sufficient for the tool to not be touching any part of the mesh.
Tool Movement Fix: Resolved an issue where the tool could not be moved out of the workpiece when in reverse mode.
Tutorial Mismatch: Corrected an issue where the milling machine tutorial was mistakenly started upon launching the lathe for the first time.
Mouse Interaction: Fixed a glitch where mouse camera interaction didn't function correctly if the mouse was positioned over the status bar at the screen's bottom.

Additions:

Chuck/Tail Stock Status: Introduced a status text for the chuck/tail stock controller, indicating its "opened" or "closed" state.
Interruptible Actions: The opening or closing action of the chuck/tail stock can now be halted by pressing the corresponding button again.
Workpiece Security: If the clamp is not secured and the machine is activated, the workpiece may fall off.
Tail Stock Drill Tool: Added functionality to insert a drill tool into the tail stock.
New Tool Addition: Introduced a new 45-degree tool for enhanced operations.
